rules.unit: one complete round to finishing order
rules.tributeReason: Fresh independent deals, no preceding round; not a tribute or full-match evaluation

pairing: Exactly the same 108 card IDs at the same seats, level and first leader; swap model/team allocation between parity 0 and 1. Mixed focal seat alternates between teammates by seed parity. Both games must complete to count a pair.
pipeline: Native ONNX CPU one thread; raw neural argmax over canonical candidates, no web personality/endgame/finishing shortcut, no Clint heuristics added to neural policies. Clint independent rules-v2 own-hand/public-only.

analysis.primary: Paired-deal mean signed upgrade points A vs B; 95% normal CI with sample SD across independent deal-pair means.
analysis.secondary: Five paired A-minus-B common-opponent/teammate contrasts; Bonferroni 99% CI for each. W/L/D, rank combinations, double-up/down and points by setting, never one pooled win rate.
analysis.stopping: Fixed sample only; no choosing checkpoints, sample expansion or early stopping by outcomes. Freeze final arm weights and deadline before observing any result.
analysis.limitations: One training replication per arm; confidence intervals quantify evaluation-deal variation, not variation across repeated training runs. No tribute or cross-round match claim.

purpose: Independent single-round A/B comparison; this file contains a plan, zero completed rounds
primaryInterpretation: A perspective; 95% seed-cluster CI for signed round upgrade points
